title: Create a Commit in a Repository
knowledge:
# Create a Commit in a Repository

## Prerequisites

- You must have access to the target repository (sufficient permissions to create Git objects/commits in that repo).

## Method

`POST`

## URL

`https://api.github.com/repos/{{owner}}/{{repo}}/git/commits`

## Headers

```json
{
  "Accept": "application/json",
  "Content-Type": "application/json"
}
```

## Description

Creates a new Git commit object in the specified repository. The created commit points to a tree SHA and may reference one or more parent commit SHAs; if no parents are provided, the commit is written as a root commit. The response includes a `verification` object describing commit signature verification results.

## Enforcement Rules

- The `owner` path parameter **must always be present** and **non-empty**.
- The `repo` path parameter **must always be present** and **non-empty**.
- Always construct the path as `/repos/{{owner}}/{{repo}}/git/commits`.
- Do **not** call the API with missing or empty path parameters (e.g., avoid `/repos//my-repo/git/commits` or `/repos/octo-org//git/commits`).
- When executing the action, ensure to send **Path Parameters** in the **URL** and **not** in the body.
- This endpoint has **no query parameters** documented; do not move body fields into the URL.

### Valid Examples

```http
/repos/octo-org/hello-world/git/commits
/repos/octocat/Spoon-Knife/git/commits
```

### Invalid Examples

```http
/repos//hello-world/git/commits
/repos/octo-org//git/commits
/repos/octo-org/hello-world/git/commit
```

## Required Path Parameters

| Parameter | Type   | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `owner`  | string | The account owner of the repository. Not case sensitive. |
| `repo`   | string | The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. Not case sensitive. |

## Required Request Body Fields

| Parameter | Type   | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `message` | string | The commit message. |
| `tree` | string | The SHA of the tree object this commit points to. |

## Optional Request Body Fields

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `parents` | string[] | Full SHAs of the parent commits. If omitted or empty, the commit will be written as a root commit. For a single parent, provide an array with one SHA; for a merge commit, provide an array with more than one SHA. |
| `author` | object | Author of the commit. If provided, `author.name` and `author.email` are required. |
| `author.name` | string | **Required if `author` is provided.** Name of the author (or committer). |
| `author.email` | string | **Required if `author` is provided.** Email of the author (or committer). |
| `author.date` | string | Timestamp when authored/committed in ISO 8601 format (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`). |
| `committer` | object | Committer of the commit. (All committer subfields are optional per provided docs.) |
| `committer.name` | string | Name of the author (or committer). |
| `committer.email` | string | Email of the author (or committer). |
| `committer.date` | string | Timestamp when authored/committed in ISO 8601 format (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`). |
| `signature` | string | ASCII-armored detached PGP signature. GitHub adds it to the `gpgsig` header of the created commit. Must be a detached PGP signature over the commit content as written to the object database. |

## Response

### Success Response (201 Created)

Headers:

- `Location`: `string`

Body (application/json):

```json
{
  "sha": "7638417db6d59f3c431d3e1f261cc637155684cd",
  "node_id": "MDY6Q29tbWl0NzYzODQxN2RiNmQ1OWYzYzQzMWQzZTFmMjYxY2M2MzcxNTU2ODRjZA==",
  "url": "https://api.github.com/repos/octocat/Hello-World/git/commits/7638417db6d59f3c431d3e1f261cc637155684cd",
  "author": {
    "date": "2008-07-09T16:13:30+12:00",
    "email": "octocat@github.com",
    "name": "Mona Octocat"
  },
  "committer": {
    "date": "2008-07-09T16:13:30+12:00",
    "email": "octocat@github.com",
    "name": "Mona Octocat"
  },
  "message": "Fix #42",
  "tree": {
    "sha": "827efc6d56897b048c772eb4087f854f46256132",
    "url": "https://api.github.com/repos/octocat/Hello-World/git/trees/827efc6d56897b048c772eb4087f854f46256132"
  },
  "parents": [
    {
      "sha": "7d1b31e74ee336d15cbd21741bc88a537ed063a0",
      "url": "https://api.github.com/repos/octocat/Hello-World/git/commits/7d1b31e74ee336d15cbd21741bc88a537ed063a0",
      "html_url": "https://github.com/octocat/Hello-World/commit/7d1b31e74ee336d15cbd21741bc88a537ed063a0"
    }
  ],
  "verification": {
    "verified": false,
    "reason": "unsigned",
    "signature": null,
    "payload": null,
    "verified_at": null
  },
  "html_url": "https://github.com/octocat/Hello-World/commit/7638417db6d59f3c431d3e1f261cc637155684cd"
}
```

> Note: The docs state `verification.signature`, `verification.payload`, and `verification.verified_at` are included; in practice these may be null depending on signature presence/verification outcome.

### Error Response (404 Not Found)

```json
{
  "message": "Not Found",
  "documentation_url": "https://docs.github.com/rest/git/commits#create-a-commit",
  "url": "https://api.github.com/repos/octocat/Hello-World/git/commits",
  "status": "404"
}
```

### Error Response (409 Conflict)

```json
{
  "message": "Conflict",
  "documentation_url": "https://docs.github.com/rest/git/commits#create-a-commit",
  "url": "https://api.github.com/repos/octocat/Hello-World/git/commits",
  "status": "409"
}
```

### Error Response (422 Unprocessable Entity)

```json
{
  "message": "Validation failed, or the endpoint has been spammed.",
  "documentation_url": "https://docs.github.com/rest/git/commits#create-a-commit",
  "errors": [
    {
      "resource": "Commit",
      "field": "tree",
      "message": "Invalid tree SHA",
      "code": "invalid",
      "index": 0,
      "value": "notasha"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Response Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `sha` | string | SHA for the commit. |
| `node_id` | string | Node ID of the commit. |
| `url` | string | API URL for the commit. |
| `author` | object | Git author info. |
| `author.date` | string | Timestamp of the commit. |
| `author.email` | string | Git email address of the user. |
| `author.name` | string | Name of the git user. |
| `committer` | object | Git committer info. |
| `committer.date` | string | Timestamp of the commit. |
| `committer.email` | string | Git email address of the user. |
| `committer.name` | string | Name of the git user. |
| `message` | string | Message describing the purpose of the commit. |
| `tree` | object | Tree referenced by the commit. |
| `tree.sha` | string | SHA for the tree. |
| `tree.url` | string | API URL for the tree. |
| `parents` | array | Parent commits. |
| `parents[].sha` | string | SHA for the parent commit. |
| `parents[].url` | string | API URL for the parent commit. |
| `parents[].html_url` | string | HTML URL for the parent commit. |
| `verification` | object | Signature verification result. |
| `verification.verified` | boolean | Whether GitHub considers the signature verified. |
| `verification.reason` | string | Reason for `verified` value (see “Verification reason values”). |
| `verification.signature` | string | Signature extracted from the commit. |
| `verification.payload` | string | The value that was signed. |
| `verification.verified_at` | string | Date the signature was verified by GitHub. |
| `html_url` | string | HTML URL for the commit. |

## Verification reason values (`verification.reason`)

| Value | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `expired_key` | The key that made the signature is expired. |
| `not_signing_key` | The "signing" flag is not among the usage flags in the GPG key that made the signature. |
| `gpgverify_error` | There was an error communicating with the signature verification service. |
| `gpgverify_unavailable` | The signature verification service is currently unavailable. |
| `unsigned` | The object does not include a signature. |
| `unknown_signature_type` | A non-PGP signature was found in the commit. |
| `no_user` | No user was associated with the `committer` email address in the commit. |
| `unverified_email` | The `committer` email address was associated with a user, but the email address is not verified on their account. |
| `bad_email` | The `committer` email address is not included in the identities of the PGP key that made the signature. |
| `unknown_key` | The key that made the signature has not been registered with any user's account. |
| `malformed_signature` | There was an error parsing the signature. |
| `invalid` | The signature could not be cryptographically verified using the key whose key-id was found in the signature. |
| `valid` | None of the above errors applied; signature is considered verified. |

## Sample Request

```bash
curl -i --location --request POST \
  'https://api.github.com/repos/octocat/Hello-World/git/commits' \
  --header 'Accept: application/json' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{
    "message": "my commit message",
    "author": {
      "name": "Mona Octocat",
      "email": "octocat@github.com",
      "date": "2008-07-09T16:13:30+12:00"
    },
    "parents": [
      "7d1b31e74ee336d15cbd21741bc88a537ed063a0"
    ],
    "tree": "827efc6d56897b048c772eb4087f854f46256132",
    "signature": "-----BEGIN PGP SIGNATURE-----\n\n...\n-----END PGP SIGNATURE-----\n"
  }'
```

## Example Usage

### Example 1: Create a commit with one parent

```bash
curl --location --request POST \
  'https://api.github.com/repos/octocat/Hello-World/git/commits' \
  --header 'Accept: application/json' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{
    "message": "Fix #42",
    "tree": "827efc6d56897b048c772eb4087f854f46256132",
    "parents": ["7d1b31e74ee336d15cbd21741bc88a537ed063a0"]
  }'
```

### Example 2: Create a root commit (no parents)

```bash
curl --location --request POST \
  'https://api.github.com/repos/octocat/Hello-World/git/commits' \
  --header 'Accept: application/json' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{
    "message": "Initial commit",
    "tree": "827efc6d56897b048c772eb4087f854f46256132",
    "parents": []
  }'
```

### Example 3: Provide explicit author and committer metadata

```bash
curl --location --request POST \
  'https://api.github.com/repos/octocat/Hello-World/git/commits' \
  --header 'Accept: application/json' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{
    "message": "Add release notes",
    "tree": "827efc6d56897b048c772eb4087f854f46256132",
    "parents": ["7d1b31e74ee336d15cbd21741bc88a537ed063a0"],
    "author": {
      "name": "Mona Octocat",
      "email": "octocat@github.com",
      "date": "2008-07-09T16:13:30+12:00"
    },
    "committer": {
      "name": "Mona Octocat",
      "email": "octocat@github.com",
      "date": "2008-07-09T16:13:30+12:00"
    }
  }'
```

## Behavior

1. Validates required body fields (`message`, `tree`) and required path parameters (`owner`, `repo`).
2. Creates a new commit object referencing the provided tree SHA.
3. Links the commit to the provided parent commit SHAs, or creates a root commit if parents are omitted/empty.
4. If `signature` is provided, GitHub stores it in the commit’s `gpgsig` header and returns `verification` results indicating signature validity.

## Notes

- `parents` controls whether the commit is a normal commit (one parent), merge commit (multiple parents), or root commit (no parents).
- Creating a verifiable `signature` requires generating an ASCII-armored detached PGP signature over the exact commit payload as it would be written to the object database (often easier via the Git CLI).

## Gotchas

- Passing an invalid `tree` SHA or malformed body commonly results in `422 Validation failed`.
- If `parents` is omitted or empty, the commit becomes a **root** commit, which is usually not what you want unless initializing history.

## Error Handling

- **404 Not Found**: Repository/resource not found.
- **409 Conflict**: Conflict creating the commit (as documented).
- **422 Unprocessable Entity**: Validation failed, or the endpoint has been spammed (includes an `errors[]` array with per-field details).
